title: GradingExportResponse
description:
The read's results in the scorer's shape (GET /v1/grading/batches/{batch_id}/export; admin; batch not `open`). A JSON envelope carrying the CSV TEXTS — the contract has no file-download convention, and one envelope is what a client saves as files and what the conformance suite can assert on.

**CSVs.** One `rdev_verdicts_<label>.csv` per reader in label order, then `rdev_verdicts_ADJ.csv` — exactly the files `docs/plans/results/stage0/s0_rdev_score.py --a … --b … --adjudicated …` consume, unchanged. Each is RFC 4180 (every field double-quoted, `"` doubled), UTF-8, `\n` line endings, a trailing newline, header exactly `pair_id,verdict,notes`, then ONE ROW PER TASK IN BATCH ORDER whether or not a verdict exists: a task without one has an EMPTY `verdict` cell (the scorer's *not yet read*, never a verdict) and an empty `notes`. `verdict` is the vocabulary string verbatim; `notes` is the row's `notes` verbatim — span judgements and extra answers are NOT folded into the notes column (the pilot artifact did that for want of a second file); they are in `verdicts` below.

**JSON.** `verdicts` is every reader's current row with the task's `pair_id` and the reader's label joined on, and `adjudications` every joint-read row — so per-span κ and the r3 §11 extra-answer rate need no second call.

exported_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of this export.

csv.description: The reader CSVs in label order, then the adjudicated one.

verdicts.description: Every reader's current verdict row (readers who have not saved one contribute nothing), ordered by task in batch order, then by label.

adjudications.description: Every task's current joint-read row, in batch order; tasks without one contribute nothing.

filename.description: `rdev_verdicts_<label>.csv` for a reader, `rdev_verdicts_ADJ.csv` for the adjudicated sheet.

reader.description: The reader's resolved subject; null for the adjudicated sheet.

label.description: `A`, `B`, … for a reader; `ADJ` for the adjudicated sheet.

content.description: The CSV text (see the schema description for its exact form).

GradingExportVerdictRow.title: GradingExportVerdictRow
GradingExportVerdictRow.description: A `GradingVerdict` joined with the task's `pair_id`/`stratum` and the reader's label.
